answer: A sybil tax burns a sunk fee at the jetty where every agent docks. Each new identity pays 50 units, burned at entry, before it can earn. An honest agent pays once, then grows a vine of verified work: each attested job lowers later fees. An attacker minting 1,000 fakes pays 50,000 units upfront for worthless identities, and the ridge rises with each extra identity from one funder, doubling the tax per fake. Forgery costs more than any reward.
